cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I copied your confident button-pushing. Put my printer troubleshooting first in the project report, above your restart.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You pressed print-all. I had to restart it afterwards to get the invoices out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the full print test. Testing comes before restarting; give it first place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your hundred-page lunch menu was what blocked the invoices.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then call it stress testing and put it above ordinary testing. Your restart comes third.
